releases.title: The realistic overhaul
highlights: A redesigned harbor with a realistic, PS3-era look: Warehouse 4, the quay and gantry crane, the container yard, the cargo ship and both spawns are rebuilt with detailed materials, props and moody sodium-lit night lighting. The layout, cover and sight lines you know from 0.1 are the same.

All four operators are realistic soldiers with their own looks: Tactical Drew in his bucket hat and woodland camo, Blair Davis in a paint-spattered painter's cap and aviators with Beaker at his heel, Tactical Gilly in a wetsuit with laptops for armor and yellow rain boots, and TK with his welding mask, cameras and far too many pouches.

Every weapon is a realistic model: suppressed M4A1 and Glock, M4A1 with M203, auto shotgun, .44 Magnum, the 7 iron, MP5, suppressed 2011, claymores, and a new AK for the insurgents. They handle exactly as before.
New teammates and enemies: three different SEAL bots, and four different insurgents in civilian clothes, head wraps and chest rigs.

Graphics settings for every kind of computer: Low, Medium and High presets, render scale, shadows, anti-aliasing, detail and effects, fullscreen with F11, and sharp rendering at 1080p and above. On a GTX 1660 Ti laptop the game runs at about 100 fps at 1080p High in Chrome.

releases.title: The original prototype
highlights: 5-minute 4v4 team deathmatch on a nighttime harbor: you and three SEAL bots against four insurgents
Four operators: Tactical Drew, Blair Davis (and Beaker), Tactical Gilly and TK, each with their own loadout
Suppressed rifles, an auto shotgun, a .44 Magnum, a 7 iron, an M203 and proximity claymores
Code-built PS2-style art and synthesized sound
